item.title: クラウド大手、まだ把握されないＡＩ関連債務存在も＝Ｓ＆Ｐ
item.description:
Marc Jones
[ロンドン １９日 ロイター] - 米格付け会社Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルは、世界の大手テクノロジー企業が...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
クラウド大手、まだ把握されないＡＩ関連債務存在も＝Ｓ＆Ｐ 9:54 配信

AIのイメージ。10月19日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Marc Jones

[ロンドン １９日 ロイター] - 米格付け会社Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルは、世界の大手テクノロジー企業が人工知能（ＡＩ）関連で抱える債務リスクについて、現時点で把握されている以上の潜在的負債が存在する可能性が高いとの見方を示した。一方で同社のデジタルインフラ部門責任者を務めるマーク・ハビブ氏は、現時点で主要企業の信用格付けを見直す必要はないとみている。

ハビブ氏はロンドンでの説明会で、大手クラウド事業者（ハイパースケーラー）の格付けにとって最大のリスクは、期待される利益が実現しないことだと指摘。その上でハイパースケーラーが大規模データセンター建設や小規模ＡＩ企業向けの資金調達を事実上保証する「相互連関型の金融スキーム」に言及するとともに「われわれが把握できていない債務がさらに存在すると考えるのが妥当だ」と述べた。

さらにハビブ氏は「（これらの取引が）開示対象になっていなければ、ハイパースケーラーの開示情報には含まれない。またこうした負債が発生する取引を当社が格付けしていなければ、実際のところ十分な可視性を持てない」と語った。

Ｓ＆Ｐは、アマゾン・ドット・コム、マイクロソフト、アルファベット、オラクル、メタ、スペースＸの米主要６社が、２０２５年から３０年までにデータセンターなどＡＩ関連設備投資として７兆ドル超を投じると予想し、少なくとも来年まではフリーキャッシュフローがマイナスになるとの見通しを示している。

ハビブ氏はこうした循環的な資金調達に伴う追加債務が企業のバランスシートにどの程度上乗せされるかについて推計はないとしつつも「全体像を総合的に捉えようとしている」と説明した。

Ｓ＆Ｐは７月、ＡＩ関連投資の大きさと「収益化への道筋が不透明」な点を理由として、オラクルの格付けを投資適格級の最低水準である「ＢＢＢマイナス」に引き下げている。

ただハビブ氏は最近のＡＩ投資ブームに関連した債券の急落について、投資家が格付け以上にリスクを意識している兆候かと質問されると「現時点では、格付け変更を迫るような大きな乖離があるとはみていない」と答えた。Ｓ＆Ｐの格付けは短期的な市場変動ではなく、長期的な視点に基づいているからだという。

一方でＡＩ関連支出の規模が持続不可能な水準に達したことが明らかになれば、見方を変える可能性があると強調。「ＡＩ企業による投資のさらなる拡大や、競争激化による収益成長率の低下など、さまざまな要因が考えられる」と付け加えた。

item.title: South Korea central bank to hold rates on October 22, hike in November
item.description: The Bank of Korea will keep its key policy rate unchanged on Thursday after two consecutive increases but is expected to raise borrowing costs once more next month, a Reuters poll of economists found, as inflation remains above target and growth remains firm.
item.dc:creator: Renusri K
item.content:encoded: The Bank of Korea will keep its key policy rate unchanged on Thursday after two consecutive increases but is expected to raise borrowing costs once more next month, a Reuters poll of economists found, as inflation remains above target and growth remains firm. Consumer inflation eased to 2.9% in [USN:L1N45N18N TEXT:"September"] from 3.1% in August, but remained above the BOK's 2% target. Strong semiconductor-led growth, a recovery in domestic demand and elevated energy costs are likely to keep underlying price pressures firm. Still, the recent moderation in headline inflation and Governor Shin Hyun Song's call for time to assess the effects of the [USN:L4N44N0CI TEXT:"back-to-back"] hikes give policymakers room to pause this month rather than deliver a third consecutive increase. All 34 economists surveyed by Reuters from October 14 to 19 expected the Bank of Korea (BOK) to hold its seven-day repurchase rate (KROCRT=ECI) at 3.00% at its October 22 meeting. "We think the BOK will buy some time, but ... that does not mean it is done with the hiking cycle," said Jeeho Yoon, senior economist at BNP Paribas. "The risks are tilted to the upside, given that growth is very strong on the back of semiconductors. This strong growth will spread into the domestic sector and domestic demand, (leading) to inflationary pressures." WEIGHING FINANCIAL STABILITY RISKS Asia's fourth-largest economy grew [USN:L1N43O1HA TEXT:"0.6%"] in the April to June quarter and 3.7% from a year earlier. The poll forecasts 3.5% growth this year, while next week's third-quarter GDP data may show whether the export-led recovery is broadening into domestic demand. Inflation is forecast to average 2.7% this year before easing to 2.2% in 2027. With growth expected to remain firm and inflation above target, median forecasts in the survey showed the BOK raising its base rate to 3.25% at its November meeting, in line with the BOK's dot plot projection. The rate is then forecast to rise to 3.50% in the first quarter of 2027 and stay there for the rest of the year. This is 25 basis points above the forecast in the previous poll, conducted before the August decision. "The November hike is still likely because the BOK's CPI projections show inflation is expected to stay at about 2% for most of 2027," said Michelle Lam, an economist at Societe Generale, who expects two more rate hikes after October in her baseline scenario. "Also, if you look at the housing market, house prices are still rising. Even though household mortgage borrowing is slowing, it does not seem that rate hikes have done enough to slow the housing market. So there is still room for the BOK to hike." Beyond inflation and growth, the BOK is also weighing financial-stability risks, particularly developments in housing, household debt and financial markets. The benchmark KOSPI index (.KS11) hit a [USN:L1N46101G TEXT:"six-month low"] on Thursday and triggered a circuit breaker for the 10th time this year, underscoring heightened market volatility. "In terms of the household (wealth) effect, of course it will affect confidence but 50% of household assets are in housing and equities account for only 10%. The impact of an equity-market correction would not be as much as that of a correction in house prices," Lam added. "If the equity-market correction continues, I think that may also affect the BOK's pace of monetary policy tightening." ([USN:L6N45N0UX TEXT:"Other stories"] from Reuters global economic poll)

item.title: テニス＝ジャパン・オープン、本玉が初戦敗退、坂詰は雨天中断
item.description: ［１９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１９日　ロイター］ - 女子テニスのジャパン・オープンは１９日、大阪市でシングルス１回戦を行い、本玉真唯はビクトリヤ・ゴルビッチ（スイス）に３─６、１─６のストレートで敗れた。

坂詰姫野は第８シードのケーティ・ボールター（英国）と対戦し、３─６、１─３とリードを許したところで雨天により試合が中断された。

ダブルス１回戦では、小堀桃子、清水綾乃組が二宮真琴、リュドミラ・キチェノク（ウクライナ）組に６─４、６─３で勝利。本玉、内島萌夏組は台湾ペアに３─６、３─６で敗れた。

シングルスではリリー・タガー（オーストリア）が第５シードのリュドミラ・サムソノワ（ロシア出身）を６─３、６─３で破る番狂わせを演じた。アシュリン・クルーガー（米国）も第６シードのジャニス・チェン（インドネシア）を６─４、６─４で破った。

item.title: Australia's Ingenia extends Warburg Pincus talks, grants due diligence access
item.description: Ingenia Communities Group said on Tuesday it has extended discussions with Warburg Pincus on a process deed and granted the US private-equity firm comprehensive due diligence access.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ingenia Communities Group (INA.AX) said on Tuesday it has extended discussions with Warburg Pincus on a process deed and granted the US private-equity firm comprehensive due diligence access. Ingenia said it would sign a process deed with Warburg Pincus no later than October 23, less than a week after it provided due dilligence to the US firm on an exclusive basis [USN:L4N45Q02W TEXT:"Earlier this month"], the Australian property developer opened its books to Warburg Pincus on a non-exclusive basis after receiving an improved takeover offer of [USN:L4N45K019 TEXT:"A$5.25 per share"] Warburg Pincus first approached Ingenia in [USN:L6N44Y09H TEXT:"early September"] with an offer of A$4.75 per share, which was later raised to [USN:L1N45D006 TEXT:"A$5.05 a share"] within two weeks Ingenia rejected the first two bids, saying they "substantially" undervalued the firm Ingenia's board said on Tuesday there was no certainty the Warburg Pincus proposal would result in a formal binding offer Ingenia continues to work with residential property developer Peet (PPC.AX) on its A$992.5 million acquisition announced in [USN:L4N44N00X TEXT:"late-August"] Shares of Ingenia were up as much as 9% and on track for their best session since September 7, if the current momentum persists

item.title: Asesinato de exfiscal anticorrupción es un sombrío hito en violencia política en Guatemala
item.description: El asesinato el fin de semana del abogado anticorrupción Juan Francisco Solórzano Foppa, quien se hizo de poderosos enemigos al enfrentarse a la élite guatemalteca, constituye uno de los homicidios políticos más significativos del país en las últimas décadas, lo que reaviva la preocupación por la vulnerabilidad de quienes luchan contra la corrupción en Centroamérica.
item.dc:creator: Sofia Menchu, Raul Cortes
item.content:encoded: El asesinato el fin de semana del abogado anticorrupción Juan Francisco Solórzano Foppa, quien se hizo de poderosos enemigos al enfrentarse a la élite guatemalteca, constituye uno de los homicidios políticos más significativos del país en las últimas décadas, lo que reaviva la preocupación por la vulnerabilidad de quienes luchan contra la corrupción en Centroamérica. Familiares, amigos y simpatizantes velaron el lunes a Solórzano, de 43 años, dos días después de que sus agresores lo asesinaran a tiros en un centro deportivo de la Ciudad de Guatemala. Su sepelio está programado para el martes. La policía guatemalteca informó haber detenido a dos hombres vinculados al homicidio y dijo haber incautado un rifle tipo carabina y una motocicleta. Ambos fueron puestos en libertad el domingo sin cargos y mantienen su inocencia. La policía indicó que aún no ha determinado el móvil del crimen. Para los guatemaltecos, el crimen trajo a la memoria el sombrío asesinato en 1998 del obispo Juan José Gerardi, quien fue golpeado hasta la muerte dos días después de presentar un informe que documentaba las atrocidades de la guerra civil de la nación centroamericana, culpando al Ejército y a sus fuerzas aliadas de la mayor parte de la violencia. "Esa magnitud y relevancia (no habíamos visto) yo creo que desde 1998 que asesinaron al padre Gerardi", dijo Juan Francisco Sandoval, exjefe de la Fiscalía Especial contra la Impunidad de Guatemala. SOLÓRZANO SEÑALÓ A LA ÉLITE Solórzano Foppa era hijo de un combatiente que murió en la guerra civil en la década de 1980 y nieto de la aclamada poeta y activista Alaíde Foppa, quien fue secuestrada en 1980 y de la que nunca más se supo. El abogado pasó de fiscal adjunto a convertirse en una figura destacada en la lucha contra la corrupción. Trabajó con la CICIG, el grupo anticorrupción respaldado por la ONU, en el caso de soborno "La Línea", que provocó la caída del presidente Otto Pérez Molina en 2015. Como director de la agencia tributaria de Guatemala desde 2016, se centró en la élite empresarial. Obtuvo un acuerdo récord de 100 millones de dólares con la siderúrgica Aceros de Guatemala e hizo arrestar al dueño del hotel Camino Real por falsificación de facturas. Sus casos permitieron recuperar aproximadamente 280 millones de dólares en impuestos. "Él tenía muchos adversarios por su trabajo en la autoridad tributaria, tenía muchos adversarios de naturaleza política, sobre todo a partir de las denuncias públicas que él realizó", dijo Sandoval, quien conocía a Solórzano Foppa desde hacía 23 años. El exfiscal fue destituido en 2018 y la CICIG se vio obligada a dimitir como parte de una reacción violenta de la poderosa élite guatemalteca. En 2021, fue arrestado bajo acusaciones de irregularidades en la recolección de firmas para registrar un nuevo partido político. "Esto no me avergüenza, avergüenza a los que están robando", dijo Solórzano Foppa en aquel momento, mostrando las esposas en sus muñecas a los periodistas en el tribunal. "Esto demuestra que estamos afectando a las personas poderosas de este país", añadió. Posteriormente, un juez desestimó los cargos más graves. En 2023, se unió brevemente al equipo de defensa del periodista de investigación del país centroamericano José Rubén Zamora, arrestado por cargos de lavado de dinero pero que afirmó ser un preso político. Solórzano solía decir que existían vínculos entre bandas criminales y partidos políticos, así como con el sistema judicial. "Me duele mucho porque no era la forma de cómo cortarle la vida a un ciudadano que le ha servido tanto al país", dijo el exministro de Gobernación Francisco Rivas, amigo de Solórzano Foppa durante 20 años. "Era una persona muy luchadora, extraordinariamente valiente, muy fuerte en cuanto a sus convicciones y valores". El presidente Bernardo Arévalo, quien hizo campaña como defensor de la lucha contra la corrupción en las elecciones que ganó en 2023, también condenó el asesinato, calificándolo el sábado como un hecho "cobarde". "Sus autores, materiales e intelectuales deben pagar las consecuencias con todo el peso de la ley”, afirmó. Solórzano Foppa deja cuatro hijos: dos de su primer matrimonio y dos con una segunda pareja. El tío del abogado, el activista de derechos humanos Julio Solórzano, sugirió que el asesinato podría ser una forma de generar miedo y desconfianza y desestabilizar el país. "Esperamos que pronto se sepa quiénes fueron los autores, pero el impacto como un crimen político ahí está", dijo durante el velatorio del lunes.

item.title: ドイツ首相、経済界にＡＩへの投資を要請
item.description: [ベルリン／フランクフルト １９日 ロイター] - ドイツのメルツ首相は１９日、「私たちは人工知能（ＡＩ）の飛躍的な進歩...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ドイツ首相、経済界にＡＩへの投資を要請 9:24 配信

10月19日、ドイツのベルリンで開催された産業イベントで登壇する メルツ独首相とエヌビディアのフアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）。 REUTERS/Lisi Niesner

[ベルリン／フランクフルト １９日 ロイター] - ドイツのメルツ首相は１９日、「私たちは人工知能（ＡＩ）の飛躍的な進歩に後押しされた、根本的な経済・技術変革の真っただ中にいる」とし、経済界の首脳らに対して「ＡＩが皆さんのデータを活用できるよう、門戸を開いてほしい」とＡＩへの投資と活用を進めるように呼びかけた。首都ベルリンで始まった産業イベントで語った。

イベントは２０日まで開かれ、ドイツ政府とエヌビディアはドイツの産業界でのＡＩ推進に向けた提携を発表する見通しだ。政府によると、経済省がエヌビディアと覚書を締結したが、詳細は明らかにされていない。

メルツ氏はイベントの開幕行事に米半導体大手エヌビディアのフアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）とともに登壇。ドイツ経済の立て直しと産業のアップデートに向けた取り組みでＡＩが果たす重要性を強調した。

ドイツの主要産業である自動車、化学、エンジニアリング企業が世界で激しい競争に直面する中で、極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」への支持が高まっている。支持率低迷にあえぐメルツ氏は、経済を成長させるよう強い圧力にさらされている。

メルツ氏はエヌビディアと協力することがドイツの将来の成功の鍵を握ると訴えた。フアン氏は、エヌビディアのソフトウエアを用いて高級自動運転タクシー（ロボタクシー）を開発しているメルセデス・ベンツなどのドイツの自動車メーカーとの協力関係を例示した。

シーメンスやドイツ銀行などが加盟するドイツの企業・投資家団体の報告書によると、２０３５年までにＡＩ、エネルギー、防衛などの分野で最大４兆１０００億ユーロ（約４兆６０００億ドル）の投資が見込まれている。

item.title: マイクロソフト、英データセンター契約撤退を発表 電力供給遅延で
item.description:
Paul Sandle
[ロンドン １９日 ロイター] - 米マイクロソフトは１９日、米半導体大手エヌビディアが出資...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
マイクロソフト、英データセンター契約撤退を発表　電力供給遅延で 9:22 配信

マイクロソフトのロゴ。2025年3月、仏パリ近郊で撮影。REUTERS/Gonzalo Fuentes

Paul Sandle

[ロンドン １９日 ロイター] - 米マイクロソフトは１９日、米半導体大手エヌビディアが出資する英クラウドサービス企業エヌスケールの旗艦データセンターで主要顧客となる契約を撤回したと正式発表した。人工知能（ＡＩ）分野で世界を主導するという英国の構想にとって大きな障害となる。

マイクロソフトは、デジタルインフラの構築や世界的なＡＩの成長支援など、エヌスケールとの提携を引き続き重視していると表明した。

マイクロソフトの広報担当者は、英エセックス州ラウトンのデータセンターに関する契約の解除について「今回の決定は１カ所の施設に関するもの」と説明。エヌスケールは同施設で電力接続の遅延に直面しており、供給開始は２０３０年代になる見通しだという。

エヌスケールの広報担当者はロイターに「マイクロソフトとの関係は引き続き強固かつ長期的なものであり、ロンドン全域に及ぶ今回の残念な電力網の問題は、当社の他の契約には影響しない」と説明。「ラウトンの事業と英国への取り組みを継続する方針に変わりはなく、この施設の代替電源に加え、英国での事業拡大に向けた他の候補地も検討している」と語った。

マイクロソフトの契約撤回は英紙テレグラフが最初に報じた。

item.title: 日経平均は続落で寄り付く、ＡＩ株に売り先行 原油・金利高止まりも重し
item.description: [東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 寄り付きの東京株式市場で日経平均は、前営業日比０．２５％（１６１円２１銭）安の６万...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日経平均は続落で寄り付く、ＡＩ株に売り先行　原油・金利高止まりも重し 9:19 配信

東京証券取引所で4月撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

[東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 寄り付きの東京株式市場で日経平均は、前営業日比０．２５％（１６１円２１銭）安の６万４７５５円４９銭と、続落してスタートした。米国市場では半導体指数（ＳＯＸ）が９営業日ぶりに反発したが、国内の関連株は売りが先行している。

米コアウィーブCRWV.Oを巡る懸念がくすぶる中、原油価格や米金利の高止まりも重し。日経平均は寄り付き後、０．８％（５５０円）安にやや下げを拡大している。

ＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連はアドバンテスト6857.Tや東京エレクトロン8035.Tが１％超安となっている。ソフトバンクグループ9984.Tは３％超安となっている。主力株はトヨタ自動車7203.Tやソニーグループ6758.Tが小安い。指数寄与度の高いファーストリテイリング9983.Tは小じっかり。

item.title: South Korean AI data centre firm Elice shares tumble in IPO debut
item.description: Shares in South Korean artificial intelligence infrastructure company Elice Group opened 16% lower than their initial public offering price in their market debut on Tuesday, after the firm raised 201.1 billion won ($151.12 million) in an IPO.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Shares in South Korean artificial intelligence infrastructure company Elice Group (0158S0.KQ) opened 16% lower than their initial public offering price in their market debut on Tuesday, after the firm raised 201.1 billion won ($151.12 million) in an IPO. The shares opened at 75,700 won, compared with the IPO price of 90,500 won, and were last trading at 66,600 won, down 27%. The KOSDAQ index was down 1%. Elice's debut tests investor appetite for AI and data centre companies after an AI-led [USN:L1N46118D TEXT:"market selloff"] that derailed some deals. Planned listings linked to data centre operators [USN:L4N45Z0H4 TEXT:"AirTrunk"] and [USN:L1N45U12T TEXT:"Firmus"], as well as [USN:L6N45H0SG TEXT:"SB Energy"], were pulled or paused as investors grew more selective and wary of high borrowing costs. Elice raised 201.1 billion won by selling 2.22 million new shares at 90,500 won each, the top of its marketed price range, according to its filing.

item.title: Lula nega que tenha armado bomba fiscal com medidas recentes
item.description: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), que busca a reeleição, negou nesta segunda-feira que medidas adotadas por seu governo nos últimos dias como o reajuste do Bolsa Família e o perdão de dívidas de microempreendedores individuais (MEI) sejam uma bomba fiscal e afirmou que há espaço no orçamento para todas elas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), que busca a reeleição, negou nesta segunda-feira que medidas adotadas por seu governo nos últimos dias como o reajuste do Bolsa Família e o perdão de dívidas de microempreendedores individuais (MEI) sejam uma bomba fiscal e afirmou que há espaço no orçamento para todas elas. "Eu não sei de onde você tirou essa ideia de que é uma bomba que vai estourar...Não é bomba", disse o presidente a uma das jornalistas que o entrevistava. "Tudo o que está sendo aprovado está nas possibilidades fiscais e no orçamento", afirmou. Especialistas do mercado financeiro avaliam as medidas como eleitoreiras e consideram que devem impactar negativamente as contas públicas. "Eu não preciso aprender responsabilidade com a Faria Lima. Responsabilidade eu tenho, porque eu sei como pai de família, como trabalhador de fábrica que recebe salário, que a gente não pode gastar o que a gente não tem e portanto nós estamos gastando aquilo que nós sabemos que é possível fazer e vamos fazer", disse Lula, na entrevista. Mais cedo nesta segunda-feira, Ministério do Planejamento e Orçamento informou em nota à imprensa que deve remanejar cerca de R$20 bilhões das contas federais de 2027 para acomodar medidas adotadas recentemente, destacando que o valor corresponde a pouco mais de 1% do total de despesas sujeitas ao limite de gastos. Sem detalhar a quais ações esse impacto se refere, a pasta disse na nota que os ajustes serão propostos ao Congresso Nacional mantendo o limite total das despesas e a meta de resultado primário.

item.title: Report: Multiple teams in mix to acquire Jets G Connor Hellebuyck
item.description: At least three teams remain involved in trade discussions for Winnipeg Jets goaltender Connor Hellebuyck as the end of his team-issued suspension approaches, ESPN reported Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: At least three teams remain involved in trade discussions for Winnipeg Jets goaltender Connor Hellebuyck as the end of his team-issued suspension approaches, ESPN reported Monday. A deal is not guaranteed before Hellebuyck's suspension expires Friday, according to the report. If Winnipeg still has not moved him, the Jets are expected to begin paying the three-time Vezina Trophy winner while continuing to keep him away from the team. Hellebuyck, 33, has been suspended without pay since failing to report for training camp after requesting a trade during the offseason. Sportsnet reported Saturday that Hellebuyck informed Winnipeg before its Oct. 2 season opener that he intended to return. The Jets then exercised their authority to impose a disciplinary suspension scheduled to expire Oct. 23. The NHL's collective bargaining agreement permits a disciplinary suspension of a "reasonable length" for a player who returns after missing training camp without permission. Hellebuyck has forfeited nearly $39,000 per day in salary, bringing his estimated losses to nearly $800,000 through Monday, according to ESPN. He has continued skating regularly in Michigan. The former Hart Trophy winner asked Winnipeg to move him this summer after spending his entire NHL career with the franchise. Hellebuyck has a full no-movement clause, giving him control over any potential destination. He is in the third season of a seven-year, $59.5 million contract. His no-movement protection changes to a modified no-trade clause next summer. Hellebuyck won his third Vezina Trophy in 2025 and also captured the Hart Trophy as the NHL's most valuable player that season. He helped the United States win Olympic gold in February. Winnipeg has opened the season 4-2-2 without Hellebuyck, with Stuart Skinner and Clay Stevenson handling the goaltending duties while general manager Kevin Cheveldayoff continues exploring trade options. --Field Level Media

item.title: Honeywell Aerospace sees business aviation growth on rising aircraft use
item.description: Honeywell Aerospace said on Monday it expects 9,950 new business jet deliveries worldwide between 2026 and 2035, raising its forecast by 4.4% from last year as higher aircraft utilization and fleet growth support demand.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Honeywell Aerospace (HONA.O) said on Monday it expects 9,950 new business jet deliveries worldwide between 2026 and 2035, raising its forecast by 4.4% from last year as higher aircraft utilization and fleet growth support demand. The forecast includes about 4,200 turboprop deliveries through 2035, bringing total aircraft deliveries to roughly 14,000, while the global business aviation fleet is expected to grow about 29% over the next decade. Growing demand for charter and fractional ownership is driving higher aircraft utilization, helping support business jet demand despite economic uncertainty and geopolitical volatility Honeywell Aerospace expects global business aviation flight hours to increase about 34% through 2035, outpacing fleet growth as operators make greater use of shared-use models "Business aircraft owners and operators are consistently flying more, ordering new business jets, expanding fleets and investing in innovations that are driving growth across the sector," said Linnea Whisler, president of Commercial Original Equipment at Honeywell Aerospace The company said North America remained the largest business aviation market, while demand was growing in Latin America and parts of Asia-Pacific, including India However, it noted that conflict in the Middle East has disrupted flight operations and paused development activity in the region

item.title: Keppel to sell 51% stake in Singapore office tower vehicle for $477 million
item.description: Singapore's Keppel said on Tuesday it would sell a 51% stake in K-Commercial, the entity that owns the Keppel South Central office building, to Keppel REIT for about S$611 million ($477.42 million).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Singapore's Keppel (KPLM.SI) said on Tuesday it would sell a 51% stake in K-Commercial, the entity that owns the Keppel South Central office building, to Keppel REIT (KASA.SI) for about S$611 million ($477.42 million). Here are the details: The asset manager said the transaction would bring its announced asset monetisation so far this year to S$3.7 billion The consideration comprises S$149 million for the equity stake and about S$462 million for the repayment of a shareholder loan extended by Keppel to K-Commercial Keppel will retain a 49% stake in K-Commercial, while its real estate division will continue to provide property management and leasing services to Keppel South Central Keppel will also have a call option to re-acquire the 51% equity stake for a nominal consideration after 70 years The divestment is expected to be completed in the second quarter of 2027 ($1 = 1.2798 Singapore dollars)

item.title: サッカー＝ロナルドに30日間の出場停止処分、ポルトガル代表合宿離脱で
item.description: ［リスボン １９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［リスボン　１９日　ロイター］ - ポルトガル・サッカー連盟（ＦＰＦ）は１９日、代表合宿中に突如離脱した主将クリスティアノ・ロナルド（４１）に対し、３０日間の出場停止処分と２５５ユーロ（約４万５０００円）の罰金を科したと発表した。

ロナルドは先月、欧州ネーションズリーグのデンマーク戦を控えて滞在していたコペンハーゲンの代表合宿地を離脱。同月２７日のノルウェー戦で出場機会がなかったことを受け、自身の起用を巡ってジョルジェ・ジェズス監督が２度にわたり「約束を破った」と非難していた。

ジェズス監督はそのような合意はなかったと否定したものの、ノルウェーに２─１で勝利した後、ロナルドの代表復帰の可能性を示していた。

ロナルドはノルウェー戦後にサポーターへのあいさつを怠ったことや、チームメートを残して合宿地を去ったことを謝罪。出場停止処分を終えた後も代表でプレーする意思があると表明していた。

ＦＰＦ会長は、問題が解決すれば連盟関係者全員がロナルドの代表復帰を望んでいると述べている。

item.title: サッカー＝トットナムが今季初勝利、コベントリー坂元は決定機も得点ならず
item.description: ［ロンドン １９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ロンドン　１９日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは１９日、トットナムがホームで坂元達裕の所属するコベントリーを３─１で下し、今季初勝利を挙げた。坂元は先発出場し、後半３３分に退いた。

トットナムは前半１４分、ジェームズ・マディソンが先制弾をマーク。コベントリーも後半４分にジャック・ルドニのゴールで追いついたものの、トットナムは同１３分にオマル・マルムシュが勝ち越し点を奪い、後半アディショナルタイムにも加点した。

坂元は前半１０分にゴール前での仕掛けから決定的なシュートを放つなど好機を演出したが、得点には絡めなかった。

トットナムは１４８日ぶりのリーグ戦勝利で、今季７試合を終えて勝ち点６とし、最下位から１６位に浮上。コベントリーは同６で１７位となった。

item.title: 再送米国防長官、イスラエル電撃訪問でネタニヤフ氏と会談＝報道
item.description:
(見出しに「UPDATE 1」のタグを付けて再送しました)
[ワシントン １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
(見出しに「UPDATE 1」のタグを付けて再送しました)

[ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - ヘグセス米国防長官が１９日、イスラエルを電撃訪問し、ネタニヤフ首相と会談したと、米ニュースサイトのアクシオスが事情に詳しい関係者２人の話として報じた。

ロイターはこの訪問を直ちに確認できなかった。米国防総省はコメントを控えた。在ワシントンのイスラエル大使館はコメント要請に直ちに回答しなかった。

前日にはトランプ米大統領が、来週行われるイスラエル総選挙を巡りネタニヤフ氏への支持を表明していた。

今回の選挙は、２０２３年１０月７日のイスラム組織ハマスによるイスラエル奇襲攻撃以降、初めてとなる。この攻撃を受けてイスラエルはパレスチナ自治区ガザ、レバノン、イランで戦闘を展開した。

世論調査によると、ネタニヤフ氏率いる宗教・民族主義勢力の連立与党は過半数を失う見通しだ。ただ、野党側も政権樹立に苦戦する可能性がある。

バンス米副大統領は１９日、デジタルメディア「２ＷＡＹ」のインタビューで、イスラエルの選挙には関与しないと述べ、ネタニヤフ氏への支持表明を控えた。

「私が支持を表明するのは米国の候補者だ。私が注力しているのは中間選挙だ」と述べた。同氏は今年、ハンガリーのブダペストを訪問し、同国の選挙でオルバン首相への支持を表明していた。

バンス氏はネタニヤフ氏について、「不支持を表明しているわけではないが、支持を表明しているわけでもない。イスラエルの選挙には関与しない」と語った。

item.title: 米国務長官、中央アジア5カ国外相と会談 ウズベクと投資合意も
item.description:
Gram Slattery Doina Chiacu
[サマルカンド（ウズベキスタン） １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Gram Slattery　Doina Chiacu

[サマルカンド（ウズベキスタン） １９日 ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は１９日、ウズベキスタンのサマルカンドで中央アジア５カ国の外相と会談した。公表された具体的成果は比較的小規模にとどまったが、米政府当局者は米国のソフトパワー拡大の機会と位置付けている。

ルビオ氏は同日午前、ウズベキスタン、カザフスタン、キルギス、タジキスタン、トルクメニスタンの外相と会談し、夜にはウズベキスタンのミルジヨエフ大統領と夕食を共にした。

トランプ政権は中央アジアを地政学上の重要な競争の場と捉え、特にレアアース（希土類）供給へのアクセス拡大を重視している。今回の訪問には米経済界から２００人超が同行した。

米国とウズベキスタンは、実施されれば総額１２０億ドルとなる幅広い分野の投資合意に署名。ウズベキスタンは平和的な宇宙探査などの原則を定める米国主導の「アルテミス合意」にも署名した。

中央アジア５カ国はロシアや中国などとも関係を維持している。ルビオ氏はこれを認め、「各国はできるだけ多くの関係を持ちたいと考えている」と語った。

item.title: フランスで騒乱続く、パリなど複数都市の一部地域で夜間外出禁止令 歴史ある市庁舎の焼失など、暴力行為に市民から批判も

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: フランス当局は19日、首都パリや北部リール、南部ニースなど複数の都市の一部地域に夜間外出禁止令を発令した。週末に行われた全国的なデモが暴動や略奪に発展し、政府は治安対策の不備を巡って対応を迫られている。 ルコルニュ首相は、一部地域で夜間外出禁止令を出すよう地方当局に要請していた。首相は、パリ全域を対象とする全面的な夜間外出禁止令は否定したが、非常事態宣言については排除しなかった。 パリ警視庁は、首都の一部地域で19日午後8時からデモを禁止する命令を出したほか、レピュブリック広場とレアールの周辺で午後11時から夜間外出禁止令を発令した。いずれも20日午前6時まで適用される。 一方、暴力行為に対して市民から抗議の声が上がっている。築140年の歴史ある建造物だった市庁舎がほぼ全焼したリモージュでは、人々が集まって抗議した。リモージュでのデモに参加した男性は「市庁舎を焼き払ったり、マリアンヌの胸像を倒したりして、何になるのだ？何にもならない。今こそ、リモージュの人々が団結する時だ」と話していた。

item.title: 独、イラン大使呼び出し ユダヤ人団体代表の殺害計画巡り
item.description: [１９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１９日 ロイター] - ドイツ外務省は１９日、国内のユダヤ人団体の代表殺害を計画した男２人に裁判所が有罪判決を言い渡したことを受け、イラン大使を呼び出したとＸへの投稿で明らかにした。

裁判所は先週、男の一人がイラン情報機関の指示を受けていたと指摘した。

イランメディアによると、イラン外務省は１９日、「根拠のない非難」を理由にドイツの駐イラン大使を呼び出した。

item.title: University of North Carolina settles federal probes by Trump administration
item.description: President Donald Trump's administration has reached a settlement deal with the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill to close 18 federal probes over alleged race discrimination and antisemitism at the university.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh, Andrew Hay
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump's administration has reached a settlement deal with the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill to close 18 federal probes over alleged race discrimination and antisemitism at the university. Trump has [USN:L4N44P05A TEXT:"targeted universities"] with probes and funding-suspension threats over [USN:L4N3SN13Z TEXT:"pro-Palestinian protests"] against US ally [USN:L6N42U0SO TEXT:"Israel's assault on Gaza"], [USN:L3N3OP05M TEXT:"diversity initiatives"], [USN:L4N3R61MM TEXT:"transgender policies"] and climate programs, leading to free speech, due process and academic freedom concerns. The voluntary settlement agreement released by both parties does not require a monetary settlement payment and will remain effective until the end of 2028. UNC did not admit to any wrongdoing or liability and the deal maintained its eligibility for federal funding. The agreement said UNC will appoint an internal administrator and establish a coordinator position in its compliance office to address discrimination, including antisemitism. The agreement asks UNC to provide mandatory antisemitism training to students, faculty and staff. The university said Elizabeth Hall, associate vice chancellor for university compliance, was appointed to serve in both roles while being the point of contact for the Justice Department and overseeing UNC's reporting obligations under the deal. The agreement prohibited face masks or coverings concealing an individual's identity during protests. It said student groups "shall be subject to discipline for antisemitic discriminatory conduct." Trump has alleged [USN:L1N4650VO TEXT:"pro-Palestinian protesters"] are antisemitic and support extremism. Protesters, including some Jewish groups, say opposing Israel's occupation of Palestinian territories and its assault on Gaza [USN:L4N3SN13Z TEXT:"is not antisemitic"] and advocacy for Palestinian rights does not imply supporting extremism. A former Justice Department attorney [USN:L4N44F1GL TEXT:"said in a whistleblower complaint"] in August the Trump administration's probes of universities over antisemitism accusations lacked evidence and had predetermined outcomes. The settlement deal said UNC will adopt and maintain "non-discriminatory" admissions policies and "not use any racial proxy." It does not prevent UNC from considering how applicants overcame adversity at a personal level and it may consider facets of family background like poverty if those considerations are applied consistently, the deal said. The Justice Department said that on a quarterly basis, UNC will send any antisemitism and race discrimination complaints it has received to the US Justice and Education departments. The Supreme Court rejected affirmative action at colleges in 2023 when it struck down race-conscious admissions programs at Harvard and UNC. Trump has cracked down on diversity initiatives, casting them as discriminatory against white people and men. Civil rights advocates say they help marginalized groups like ethnic minorities, LGBT communities and women. The government has also settled with some other schools. Last year, Columbia University [USN:L1N3TL0SD TEXT:"agreed to pay"] more than $200 million to the government to resolve probes and Brown University said it would pay $50 million to support local workforce development under a [USN:L1N3TR1FV TEXT:"settlement"]. Harvard has yet to make a deal.

item.title: Colapso de mina ilegal de oro deja 14 muertos en el suroeste de Colombia
item.description: Al menos catorce personas muertas y siete heridas dejó el colapso de una mina de oro a cielo abierto en el suroeste de Colombia, en una región afectada por la minería ilegal, informaron el lunes las autoridades locales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Al menos catorce personas muertas y siete heridas dejó el colapso de una mina de oro a cielo abierto en el suroeste de Colombia, en una región afectada por la minería ilegal, informaron el lunes las autoridades locales. El accidente se registró en la zona rural del municipio de Santa Bárbara de Iscuandé, en el departamento de Nariño, una región con presencia de grupos armados ilegales que se disputan el control territorial en medio del conflicto armado interno de más de seis décadas que ha dejado alrededor de 500.000 muertos. "Hay familias enteras que han perdido la vida en este lamentable hecho que nos llena de mucho pesar", dijo en un comunicado el gobernador de Nariño, Luis Alfonso Escobar. Las víctimas fueron rescatadas por habitantes de la zona y socorristas con el apoyo de retroexcavadoras, dijo la Unidad de Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres. Un accidente similar que se registró en esa misma región de Colombia en agosto dejó trece personas muertas. El departamento de Nariño es una de las regiones del país más afectadas por la minería ilegal, de acuerdo con las autoridades. La minería informal y sin regulación es común en las zonas rurales de Colombia, donde las operaciones suelen carecer de una infraestructura de seguridad adecuada, lo que provoca frecuentes accidentes mortales. La extracción ilegal de oro y el narcotráfico son las principales fuentes de financiación de los grupos armados ilegales como las guerrillas izquierdistas y las bandas criminales, según fuentes de seguridad. La superficie con explotación de oro de aluvión en Colombia creció un 4,5% interanual en 2025 y alcanzó un récord de 118.410 hectáreas, impulsada por la expansión de la actividad en tierras de comunidades negras, reveló a comienzos de octubre un informe de la Oficina de las Naciones Unidas contra la Droga y el Delito (UNODC) y del Gobierno.

item.title: Lakers release former first-round pick Dalton Knecht
item.description: The Los Angeles Lakers waived former first-round pick Dalton Knecht on Monday to reach the NBA roster limit of 15 players ahead of the 5 p.m. ET deadline.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Los Angeles Lakers waived former first-round pick Dalton Knecht on Monday to reach the NBA roster limit of 15 players ahead of the 5 p.m. ET deadline. Knecht, a forward, averaged 4.2 points and 1.4 rebounds in 10.2 minutes across 54 games (one start) last season. The previous season, Knecht averaged 9.1 points and 2.8 rebounds in 78 games (16 starts) as a rookie and looked like a promising rotation player. During the 2026 preseason, Knecht averaged 2.8 points and shot 25% (3 of 12) from the field. The 25-year-old scored 11 points in 22 minutes against the Golden State Warriors on Oct. 6 and was scoreless in each of his other three appearances. The 6-foot-6 Knecht was the 17th overall selection of the 2024 NBA Draft after being the Southeastern Conference Player of the Year and a consensus first-team All-American at Tennessee. That was his lone season with the Volunteers. He spent the previous two seasons at Northern Colorado after playing two seasons at Northeastern Junior College in Colorado. --Field Level Media

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝阪神、佐藤輝の大リーグ挑戦容認 メッツ・ヤンキースなど候補か
item.description: ［１９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１９日　ロイター］ - プロ野球阪神は１９日、今季セ・リーグの三冠王に輝いた佐藤輝明内野手（２７）がポスティングシステムを利用して米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）に挑戦することを容認したと発表した。

佐藤輝は今季全１４３試合に出場し、打率３割６厘、３９本塁打、１０６打点を記録。史上９人目、阪神では１９８６年のランディ・バース氏以来４０年ぶり２人目となる三冠王を獲得した。

昨季は４０本塁打、１０２打点をマークし、二冠でセ・リーグの最優秀選手（ＭＶＰ）に選出された。２０２１年のプロ入りから６年間の通算成績は８０３試合出場、打率２割７分１厘、１６３本塁打、５１８打点。２３年には阪神の日本シリーズ制覇に貢献し、今年のワールド・ベースボール・クラシック（ＷＢＣ）にも日本代表として出場した。

ポスティングシステムの正式な手続きが完了すれば、ＭＬＢ全３０球団と４５日間にわたり契約交渉が可能となる。契約が成立した場合、阪神には契約金額に応じた譲渡金が支払われる。期間内に合意に至らなければ、来季も阪神に残留する。

一部報道によると、メッツ、ヤンキース、ドジャース、フィリーズなどが獲得候補として挙がっている。

item.title: Waymo plans to quintuple fleet to 20,000, Semafor reports
item.description: Alphabet's self-driving unit Waymo plans to expand its fleet five-fold to 20,000 by the end of next year using $5 billion it raised earlier this month, Semafor reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) self-driving unit Waymo plans to expand its fleet five-fold to 20,000 by the end of next year using [USN:L6N45U0Z0 TEXT:"$5 billion"] it raised earlier this month, Semafor reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter. The autonomous ride-hailing service provider, which currently has 4,000 cars, wants to expand it to 8,000 by the end of the year and grow it to 20,000 by the end of next year, Semafor reported Waymo did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours Waymo [USN:L6N45U0Z0 TEXT:"secured"] a $5 billion loan earlier this month from lenders including PIMCO, Blackstone and Sixth Street, and said it will use the funds to expand its services across the US and internationally Waymo operates in 15 US cities and has announced plans to roll out rides in [USN:L3N3VV1J3 TEXT:"London"], [USN:L1N457018 TEXT:"Tokyo"], [USN:L6N4590GI TEXT:"Singapore"] and [USN:L6N4620LY TEXT:"Canada"] The company closed a [USN:L4N3YY1ZH TEXT:"$16 billion"] equity raise earlier this year at a valuation of $126 billion

item.title: 14 dead, 7 injured in Colombia illegal gold mine collapse
item.description: 14 people were killed and 7 others injured following the collapse of an illegal gold mine in southwestern Colombia, local authorities said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: 14 people were killed and 7 others injured following the collapse of an illegal gold mine in southwestern Colombia, local authorities said on Monday. The accident took place in the rural Chambero sector of the Santa Barbara de Iscuande municipality, located in the province of Nariño. Search and rescue operations have concluded, Nariño Governor Luis Alfonso Escobar said. The governor called on the national government, the National Mining Agency, and the Ministry of Mines and Energy to accelerate the formalization process for illegal and small-scale miners to improve working conditions and safety standards. In August, 13 people died in a similar mining accident in the town of Policarpa, also in Nariño. Informal and unregulated mining is common in rural parts of Colombia, where operations often lack adequate safety infrastructure, leading to frequent fatal accidents.

item.title: Killing of former anti-graft prosecutor a grim milestone in Guatemala's political violence
item.description: The assassination at the weekend of anti-graft lawyer Juan Francisco Solorzano Foppa, who made powerful enemies by taking on Guatemala's elite, marks one of the most significant political killings in the country in recent decades, renewing concerns about the vulnerability of those who fight corruption in Central America.
item.dc:creator: Sofia Menchu, Raul Cortes
item.content:encoded: The assassination at the weekend of anti-graft lawyer Juan Francisco Solorzano Foppa, who made powerful enemies by taking on Guatemala's elite , marks one of the most significant political killings in the country in recent decades, renewing concerns about the vulnerability of those who fight corruption in Central America. Family, friends and supporters held a wake for Solorzano, 43, on Monday, two days after he was shot dead by two assailants at a Guatemala City sports center. His burial is scheduled for Tuesday. Guatemalan police said they had detained two men in relation to the killing, and seized a carbine-style firearm and a motorcycle. Both were released on Sunday without charge and maintain their innocence. Police said they have yet to establish a motive for the killing. For Guatemalans, it brought back grim memories of the 1998 assassination of Bishop Juan José Gerardi, who was beaten to death two days after presenting a damning report that documented atrocities from Guatemala's civil war, blaming the army and its allied forces for most of the violence. "In terms of magnitude and significance, I think (we have to go back) to 1998, when Father Gerardi was killed," said Juan Francisco Sandoval, former head of Guatemala's Special Prosecutor's Office Against Impunity. SOLORZANO TARGETED THE ELITE Juan Francisco Solorzano Foppa was the son of a guerrilla fighter who died in the civil war in the 1980s, and the grandson of the acclaimed poet and activist Alaíde Foppa, who was abducted in 1980 and never seen again. Solorzano rose from assistant prosecutor to become a leading anti-corruption figure. He worked with the UN-backed anti-corruption group CICIG on the "La Línea" bribery case, which brought down [USN:S0N32508G TEXT:"President Otto Pérez Molina"] in 2015. As head of Guatemala's tax agency from 2016, he targeted the business elite. He won a record $100 million settlement from the steelmaker Aceros de Guatemala and had the Camino Real hotel owner arrested over false invoices. His cases recovered about $280 million in taxes. "He had many adversaries because of his work at the tax authority, and many political adversaries, especially because of the public accusations he made," said Sandoval, who had known Solorzano for 23 years. Solorzano was fired in 2018 and CICIG was forced out as part of a backlash by Guatemala's powerful entrenched elite. In 2021, he was [USN:L5N2N65IF TEXT:"arrested"] over accusations of irregularities in signatures collected to register a new party. "This does not give me any shame," Solorzano said at the time, showing the handcuffs on his wrists to reporters in court. "This shows we are touching the powerful people of this country." A judge later dismissed the most serious charges. In 2023, he briefly joined the defense team of Guatemalan investigative journalist Jose Ruben Zamora, who was [USN:S0N3KZ0DY TEXT:"arrested"] on money laundering charges but said he was a political prisoner. Solorzano regularly asserted links between criminal gangs and political parties, as well as the judicial system. "It hurts me deeply, because this is not how you end the life of a citizen who has given so much to the country," said former Interior Minister Francisco Rivas, a friend of Solorzano for 20 years. "He was a fighter, extraordinarily brave, and very firm in his convictions and values." President Bernardo Arevalo, who campaigned as an anti-corruption champion in the election he won in 2023, also condemned the killing, calling it a "cowardly" murder on Saturday. "Both the direct perpetrators and those who ordered the crime must face the full weight of the law," he said. Solorzano leaves four children: two from a first marriage and two with a second partner. Solorzano's uncle, human rights activist Julio Solorzano, suggested the murder could be a way to generate fear and distrust and to destabilize the country. "We hope it will soon be known who the perpetrators were, but its impact as a political crime has already been felt," he said during the wake on Monday.

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 19 : OpenAI is racing to secure investor commitments before rival Anthropic's expected public market debut in mid-November, in an unusually fast fundraising that could value the ChatGPT maker at over $1.4 trillion, according to two people familiar with the matter. The rapid timetable reflects, in part, a desire to get ahead of Anthropic as the two frontier labs are increasingly tapping in to a similar investor base, the people said, adding that OpenAI wants to capitalize on its recent revenue growth after launching new models. SoftBank Group, Abu Dhabi-based MGX and other existing backers of OpenAI are in talks to join the round of about $30 billion, one of the people said.  The acceleration underscores how closely the two AI developers are competing for capital as both pursue trillion-dollar price tags, amid growing concern about rising interest rates, significant volatility in technology stocks and rising scrutiny of AI valuations. OpenAI held meetings with long-only funds and sovereign wealth funds last week while Anthropic was hosting its own investor day. OpenAI's funding round is expected to move faster than is typical for an offering of its size, the people said.

Investors familiar with the company say OpenAI also needs capital to fund its substantial infrastructure commitments and bolster its balance sheet if a deterioration in the IPO markets further delays its planned 2027 listing.  Though there is high demand for the shares of both companies, investors face the challenge of evaluating and allocating capital to two complex, competing offerings within days or weeks of each other. Some investors view OpenAI’s financing push as an effort to lock in capital from funds that might otherwise devote more of their resources to Anthropic’s IPO, the people said.  OpenAI and SoftBank declined to comment. Anthropic and MGX did not immediately respond to requests for comment. TRYING TO HEAD OFF COMPARISONS OpenAI is pitching investors on growth that accelerated after the launch of its GPT-6 Astra model, saying it had reached $50 billion in annualized revenue and expecting that figure to rise to $70 billion by year-end, according to one of the people. OpenAI has also cut prices on its cheaper models, which it said has boosted usage, and told investors it can further lower the price of AI models, the person added.  Anthropic's annualized revenue reached roughly $65 billion by July, Reuters previously reported. Its quarterly revenue jumped to $16.8 billion in the third quarter from $11.6 billion in the second quarter this year, it told investors, but slowing month-to-month revenue growth has raised concerns among investors about its valuation. OpenAI is seeking to complete the fundraising before Anthropic’s financial disclosures give investors a fuller picture of its business and invite comparisons between the two companies, one person said.  The disclosures could prompt investors to press OpenAI Chief Financial Officer Sarah Friar for more details about the company’s revenue growth and financial outlook, the person added. OpenAI records revenue on a net basis by subtracting partner shares upfront. It has accused Anthropic of inflating its revenue by counting  the full, gross value of contracts sold through third-party cloud providers. Anthropic told Reuters earlier that it follows established accounting practices. "OpenAI could want to set its own valuation and not have to worry about a comp (comparison)," said Edward Best, co-chair of capital markets at Willkie Farr & Gallagher, who is not working on the deal and commented on a hypothetical basis. "It's really a two-horse race in terms of being public."  OpenAI was last valued at $852 billion in March this year, after a record-breaking $122 billion funding round, including a commitment from Amazon.com, which agreed to invest up to $50 billion in the lab.  The Financial Times previously reported some details of OpenAI’s potential fundraising.   IPO PLANS HIT BY MARKET JITTERS A number of companies preparing to go public have decided to wait until after Anthropic’s planned IPO, wary of competing for investor demand amid market volatility and a pullback in AI stocks, bankers and investors said. Some late-stage companies are also timing private fundraising rounds to avoid coinciding with Anthropic’s expected debut, the bankers and investors said. Some existing and prospective Anthropic investors have argued for a valuation closer to $1.5 trillion for its market debut — instead of the desired $2 trillion — after the AI startup's third-quarter results fell short of expectations, Reuters reported last week. The reassessment comes amid a choppy market since September, with volatility in oil prices, rising bond yields and growing concerns about AI safety weighing on investor appetite for technology stocks. Investors are also scrutinizing the cost of AI infrastructure, including the debt needed to finance the data centers powering the boom. At the center of the latest concerns is cloud provider CoreWeave, whose shares and debt tumbled last week as investors scrutinized the nearly $50 billion in borrowings used to fund its rapid expansion.  The uncertainty has disrupted what had been expected to be a busy autumn for IPOs, with companies reassessing their listing plans amid market volatility and concerns about valuations. Blackstone-backed AirTrunk REIT, Nvidia-backed Firmus and SoftBank-backed SB Energy have either pulled or paused their listings.  Nuclear services company Holtec cited a "perfect storm," driven mainly by uncertainty around data-center demand, when it pulled its US listing last month. Companies in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, widely viewed as a proxy for AI-related semiconductor demand, have shed $1.6 trillion in less than two weeks, while AI infrastructure companies have come under particular pressure.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Reports: Aaron Boone to return as Yankees manager
item.description: The New York Yankees are bringing back Aaron Boone for his 10th season as manager, multiple media outlets reported Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New York Yankees are bringing back Aaron Boone for his 10th season as manager, multiple media outlets reported Monday. Boone, 53, will enter the final season of a two-year, $10.5 million extension he signed in February 2025. Hired to replace Joe Girardi in December 2017, Boone holds a 790-565 regular-season record. The Yankees have reached the postseason in eight of his nine seasons, but have been eliminated in the American League Division Series in each of the past two years and have reached the World Series just once. New York lost to the Los Angeles Dodgers in five games in 2024 and has gone 13 consecutive postseason appearances without a title, the fourth-longest such drought in postseason history. The Yankees' 17-year title drought is the second-longest in franchise history. Boone's regular-season winning percentage of .583 ranks among the best in major league history, while the Yankees have finished above .500 in each of his seasons as manager. New York currently holds the major league record with 34 consecutive winning seasons. As in the 2024 World Series, errors proved costly for the Yankees this fall. In Game 2 of the ALDS against the Rays, New York lost after committing three first-inning errors. Tampa Bay swept the Yankees in Game 3. "You go through a lot as a group and then it's just a sudden end," Boone said after Game 3. "It's the worst fricking feeling in the world. You know, again, offering that perspective with all due respect. And I have that perspective of we are playing a game. I understand that. But it doesn't lessen the pain of the ending, you know, and hopefully that's something that again continues to fuel guys that are going through this for the first time and then those of us that have been through it a lot." --Field Level Media

The rapid timetable reflects, in part, a desire to get ahead of Anthropic as the two frontier labs are increasingly tapping in to a similar investor base, the people said, adding that OpenAI wants to capitalize on its recent revenue growth after launching new models. SoftBank Group (9984.T) , Abu Dhabi-based MGX and other existing backers of OpenAI are in talks to join the round of about $30 billion, one of the people said. The acceleration underscores how closely the two AI developers are competing for capital as both pursue trillion-dollar price tags, amid growing concern about rising interest rates, significant volatility in technology stocks and rising scrutiny of AI valuations. OpenAI held meetings with long-only funds and sovereign wealth funds last week while Anthropic was hosting its own [USN:L6N4601AA TEXT:"investor day"]. OpenAI's funding round is expected to move faster than is typical for an offering of its size, the people said. Investors familiar with the company say OpenAI also needs capital to fund its substantial infrastructure commitments and bolster its balance sheet if a deterioration in the IPO markets further delays its planned 2027 listing. Though there is high demand for the shares of both companies, investors face the challenge of evaluating and allocating capital to two complex, competing offerings within days or weeks of each other. Some investors view OpenAI’s financing push as an effort to lock in capital from funds that might otherwise devote more of their resources to Anthropic’s IPO, the people said. OpenAI and SoftBank declined to comment. Anthropic and MGX did not immediately respond to requests for comment. TRYING TO HEAD OFF COMPARISONS OpenAI is pitching investors on growth that accelerated after the launch of its GPT-6 Astra model, saying it had reached $50 billion in annualized revenue and expecting that figure to rise to $70 billion by year-end, according to one of the people. OpenAI has also cut prices on its cheaper models, which it said has boosted usage, and told investors it can further lower the price of AI models, the person added. Anthropic's annualized revenue reached roughly $65 billion by July, Reuters previously reported. Its quarterly revenue jumped to $16.8 billion in the third quarter from $11.6 billion in the second quarter this year, it told investors, but slowing month-to-month revenue growth has raised concerns among investors about [USN:L6N46118I TEXT:"its valuation"]. OpenAI is seeking to complete the fundraising before Anthropic’s financial disclosures give investors a fuller picture of its business and invite comparisons between the two companies, one person said. The disclosures could prompt investors to press OpenAI Chief Financial Officer Sarah Friar for more details about the company’s revenue growth and financial outlook, the person added. OpenAI records revenue on a net basis by subtracting partner shares upfront. It has [USN:L6N42D13P TEXT:"accused Anthropic of inflating"] its revenue by counting the full, gross value of contracts sold through third-party cloud providers. Anthropic told Reuters earlier that it follows established accounting practices. "OpenAI could want to set its own valuation and not have to worry about a comp (comparison)," said Edward Best, co-chair of capital markets at Willkie Farr & Gallagher, who is not working on the deal and commented on a hypothetical basis. "It's really a two-horse race in terms of being public." [USN:L6N40K172 TEXT:"OpenAI was last valued at $852 billion"] in March this year, after a record-breaking $122 billion funding round, including a commitment from Amazon.com (AMZN.O) , which agreed to invest up to $50 billion in the lab. The Financial Times previously reported some details of OpenAI’s potential fundraising. IPO PLANS HIT BY MARKET JITTERS A number of companies preparing to go public have decided to wait until after Anthropic’s planned IPO, wary of competing for investor demand amid market volatility and a pullback in AI stocks, bankers and investors said. Some late-stage companies are also timing private fundraising rounds to avoid coinciding with Anthropic’s expected debut, the bankers and investors said. Some existing and prospective Anthropic investors have argued for a valuation closer to [USN:L6N46118I TEXT:"$1.5 trillion"] for its market debut — instead of the desired $2 trillion — after the AI startup's third-quarter results fell short of expectations, Reuters reported last week. The reassessment comes amid a choppy market since September, with volatility in oil prices, rising bond yields and growing concerns about AI safety weighing on investor appetite for technology stocks. Investors are also scrutinizing the cost of AI infrastructure, including the debt needed to finance the data centers powering the boom. At the center of the latest concerns is cloud provider CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , [USN:L4N461208 TEXT:"whose shares and debt tumbled last week"] as investors scrutinized the nearly $50 billion in borrowings used to fund its rapid expansion. The uncertainty has disrupted what had been expected to be a busy autumn for IPOs, with companies reassessing their listing plans amid market volatility and concerns about valuations. Blackstone (BX.N) -backed AirTrunk REIT, Nvidia (NVDA.O) -backed Firmus and SoftBank-backed SB Energy have either [USN:L4N45Z0RI TEXT:"pulled or paused their listings"]. Nuclear services company Holtec cited a "perfect storm," driven mainly by uncertainty around data-center demand, when it [USN:L4N45H14U TEXT:"pulled its US listing last month"]. Companies in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, widely viewed as a proxy for AI-related semiconductor demand, have shed $1.6 trillion in less than two weeks, while AI infrastructure companies have come under particular pressure.

item.title: The Super Bowl is coming to LA, and neither home team is likely to make the party
item.description: Los Angeles will host the Super Bowl in February, and at this rate, neither of the city's NFL teams will be there unless they buy a ticket like everyone else.
item.dc:creator: Rory Carroll
item.content:encoded: Los Angeles will host the Super Bowl in February, and at this rate, neither of the city's NFL teams will be there unless they buy a ticket like everyone else. The Rams and Chargers began the season with big expectations. Through the first third of the campaign, both have tripped over them. The Rams, a popular pick to win the Lombardi Trophy, fell to 2-4 on Sunday with an 18-16 home loss to the Arizona Cardinals. Kicker Chad Ryland was the only Cardinal who needed to show up. He made all six of his field goal attempts and scored every one of Arizona's points. "There's nothing positive that I can say," Rams coach Sean McVay said. It's a steep fall for a team that won the title after the 2021 season, when the Super Bowl was also played at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California. Hopes rose even higher when the Rams added defensive end Myles Garrett and talked Aaron Donald out of retirement in the offseason. On paper, that looked like a historically dominant defense. In reality, Garrett hasn't played since the season opener because of a knee injury, and he's expected to sit out again next weekend. The offense, led by reigning league MVP Matthew Stafford, can't find its rhythm, especially on third down. McVay's pass-heavy play calling has also drawn heavy criticism. WINLESS CHARGERS The Rams still have time to recover. The Chargers have a much steeper climb after a 22-6 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs at Arrowhead Stadium dropped them to 0-6. Before the season, they were seen as dark-horse Super Bowl contenders. Quarterback Justin Herbert and the offense have been hit by injuries to key offensive linemen and receivers. Wide receiver Ladd McConkey left Sunday's game with a concussion. "We have to address everything, and especially offensively," Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh said. "It starts with me." The Rams will try to get back on track next week when they visit the 3-3 Las Vegas Raiders. The Chargers have a bye, then play the Rams on November 1 at SoFi Stadium, the state-of-the-art venue the teams share. In that game the Chargers are the designated visitors, so will be looking for their first win as the road team in their own building.

item.title: カナダ9月の消費者物価、前年比上昇率が3.1％に拡大
item.description:
Promit Mukherjee
[オタワ １９日 ロイター] - カナダ統計局が１９日発表した９月の消費者物価指数（...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
カナダ9月の消費者物価、前年比上昇率が3.1％に拡大 8:05 配信

食料品店で買い物をする人ら。1月26日、カナダ・オンタリオ州ミシサガで撮影。REUTERS/Carlos Osorio

Promit Mukherjee

[オタワ １９日 ロイター] - カナダ統計局が１９日発表した９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前年同月比上昇率が３．１％となり、カナダ銀行（中央銀行）のインフレ目標圏（１―３％）を３カ月ぶりに上回った。ガソリンとディーゼル燃料（軽油）の価格高騰が全体を押し上げた。

ロイターがアナリストらに調査した市場予想は３．２％、８月は３．０％だった。

・９月のＣＰＩの前月比は０．１％上昇。８月は０．１％下落していた。

・カナダ銀行は今月２８日の次回会合で政策金利を２．２５％に据え置くとの見方が優勢。１２月には２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げが織り込まれている。

・カナダ銀行のティフ・マックレム総裁は、今月２８日に発表する四半期のインフレ見通しを大幅に引き上げる見込みを明らかにしている。

・９月のＣＰＩの前年同月比が上昇したのは、エネルギー価格が１９％上昇したことが主因。ガソリン価格は２７．８％上がった。ガソリン価格の影響を除いたインフレ率は２．２％となり、８月の２．４％から縮小した。

・９月の食品のインフレ率は１．７％で２０２４年５月以来、２年４カ月ぶりの低水準。

・住居費のインフレ率は１．８％、家賃は２．８％だった。

・航空運賃は１９．４％上昇。旅行代金のインフレ率は８月から縮小した。

・構成品目変動率の中央値を示す「ＣＰＩメジアン」は９月に１．９％、極端な価格変動の項目を除外した「ＣＰＩトリム」は１．８％だった。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 焦点：カナダ首相の対米強硬姿勢に高い国内支持、貿易戦争長期化で風向き一変も 焦点：中国車メーカー、カナダ進出に本腰　米市場開放にらみ「予行演習」 アングル：アルバータ州、天然ガスでデータセンター誘致　カナダ政府の環境政策と対立 焦点：カナダ、トランプ関税後の新貿易秩序に布石　中国などと協定加速 最終更新: 10/20(火) 8:05 ロイター

item.title: Texans WR Tank Dell (knee) set to return after 22-month recovery
item.description: Texans receiver Tank Dell will take the field for the first time in 22 months when Houston hosts the New York Giants on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Texans receiver Tank Dell will take the field for the first time in 22 months when Houston hosts the New York Giants on Sunday. Dell sustained a serious knee injury in Week 16 of the 2024 season against the Kansas City Chiefs and missed all of last season. Texans coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Dell is ready to return to action. "No huge expectations from what he needs to do," Ryans said of Dell. "We're all just going to be excited. I know me personally, I'm just going to be excited to see him just out there for the first time in (nearly) two years, just getting some game action. I'm just thankful, grateful for him to have this opportunity to return. I don't have any expectations. I'm just happy to see him out there and that's the only thing that matters." Dell was injured while making a 30-yard touchdown catch in the third quarter against the Chiefs on Dec. 21, 2024. He dislocated his kneecap, tore three ligaments (ACL, MCL, LCL) and tore the meniscus. Dell, who turns 27 on Oct. 29, started this season on injured reserve. The Texans opened his 21-day practice window on Oct. 6 and Dell began practicing the following day. Ryans said that Dell's explosiveness remains impressive. "He's still quick as ever," Ryans said. "Ask our defenders who was covering him the past couple weeks, he's been putting us in some tough matchups and practice the past two weeks. I expect him to go out on Sunday and do the same thing. Really stress defenders and that's what Tank is going to do with his speed, his playmaking ability." Dell made 98 catches for 1,376 yards and 10 touchdowns in 25 games (18 starts) over his first two NFL seasons. He was a third-round pick in 2023 out of Houston. --Field Level Media

item.title: Rams WR Davante Adams (hamstring) out 6-10 weeks
item.description: The Los Angeles Rams will be without three-time, first-team All-Pro wide receiver Davante Adams for six to 10 weeks due to a hamstring injury, coach Sean McVay told reporters Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Los Angeles Rams will be without three-time, first-team All-Pro wide receiver Davante Adams for six to 10 weeks due to a hamstring injury, coach Sean McVay told reporters Monday. Adams, 33, appeared to sustain the injury -- which McVay described as a ruptured semitendinosus -- while running a route into the end zone late in Sunday's 18-16 home loss to the Arizona Cardinals. A six-time Pro Bowl selection, Adams has 30 receptions for 480 yards and four touchdowns in six games this season. Over 13 seasons with the Green Bay Packers (2014-21), Las Vegas Raiders (2022-24), New York Jets (2024) and Rams, the Packers' 2014 third-round draft pick has 1,047 catches for 13,113 yards and 121 touchdowns. Adams wasn't the only player to go down Sunday. Nose tackle Poona Ford suffered a season-ending ruptured triceps, according to McVay, while defensive tackle Kobie Turner is expected to miss four to six weeks with a groin injury and likely will be placed on injured reserve. Kicker Blake Grupe was placed on injured reserve Monday after tearing his ACL on Sunday. McVay said the Rams are "working on some different options" following Grupe's injury. Grupe was added to the roster last week when the Rams released Harrison Mevis. As for pass rusher Myles Garrett, McVay said he will not return to practice this week. Following mid-September knee surgery, the five-time first-team All-Pro has missed the last five games. Cornerback Trent McDuffie, who missed Sunday's game after suffering a groin injury at practice last week, is "progressing," according to McVay. "He's feeling much better," McVay said. "The hope is progress this week and kind of determine his status at the end of this week." With Adams out, the Rams will discuss adding a receiver. Along with first-team All-Pro Puka Nacua, Los Angeles' active roster includes receivers Konata Mumpfield, Jordan Whittington, Tutu Atwell, C.J. Daniels and Alex Bachman. Mumpfield leads that group with eight receptions for 127 yards and one touchdown. --Field Level Media

item.title: Mexicano Banamex coloca 900 mln dlr en bonos AT1: comunicado
item.description: Banamex anunció el lunes la colocación de 900 millones de dólares en instrumentos de capital híbrido conocidos como Additional Tier 1 (AT1), una operación con la que busca fortalecer su estructura de capital. Los títulos perpetuos pagan una tasa anual de 9.50% y podrán ser amortizados anticipadamente por el banco a partir de 5.5 años después de su emisión, según un comunicado de la empresa.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Banamex anunció el lunes la colocación de 900 millones de dólares en instrumentos de capital híbrido conocidos como Additional Tier 1 (AT1), una operación con la que busca fortalecer su estructura de capital. Los títulos perpetuos pagan una tasa anual de 9.50% y podrán ser amortizados anticipadamente por el banco a partir de 5.5 años después de su emisión, según un comunicado de la empresa. La institución dijo que la oferta registró una sobredemanda de inversionistas de Estados Unidos, Europa, Asia y América Latina. La operación ocurre mientras Banamex busca consolidarse como entidad independiente tras separarse de Citigroup luego de que el grupo estadounidense canceló la venta del negocio y optó por escindir y listar la unidad mexicana.

item.title: Hegseth meets Netanyahu in unannounced visit to Israel, reports Axios
item.description: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu during an unannounced visit to Israel on Monday, Axios reported, citing two sources with knowledge.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu during an unannounced visit to Israel on Monday, Axios reported, citing two sources with knowledge. Reuters could not immediately confirm the visit. The Pentagon declined comment, while Israel's embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment. News of Hegseth's trip comes a day after US President Donald Trump [USN:L1N46403J TEXT:"endorsed"] Netanyahu in next week's parliamentary election in Israel - its first vote since the Hamas attack on October 7, 2023, that shook the country and plunged the Middle East into turmoil, as Israel went to war in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran. Netanyahu's religious-nationalist coalition is projected to lose its governing majority, although the opposition may also struggle to form a government, opinion polls show. US Vice President JD Vance, however, declined to endorse Netanyahu in an interview earlier on Monday, saying he was not getting involved in Israeli elections. "I endorse American candidates, and that's where I'm focused on is the midterms," Vance, who traveled to Budapest and [USN:L1N40Q06M TEXT:"endorsed"] Viktor Orban in Hungarian election earlier this year, said in an interview with digital media outlet 2WAY. "I'm not anti-endorsing him, but I'm not pro-endorsing him, I'm not getting involved in Israeli elections." Vance said.
